mapper.sql: i.inquiry_id AS inquiryId, i.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS memberNickname, i.inquiry_category AS inquiryCategory, i.title, i.content, i.inquiry_status AS inquiryStatus, i.answer_content AS answerContent, i.answered_by_member_id AS answeredByMemberId, i.answered_at AS answeredAt, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_inquiries ( member_id, inquiry_category, title, content ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{request.inquiryCategory}, #{request.title}, #{request.content} )
mapper.select: SELECT inquiry_image_id AS inquiryImageId, inquiry_id AS inquiryId, image_url AS imageUrl, display_order AS displayOrder FROM member_inquiry_images WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} AND inquiry_image_id = #{inquiryImageId}

SELECT
FROM member_inquiries i INNER JOIN members m ON m.member_id = i.member_id WHERE i.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_inquiries SET inquiry_status = 'ANSWERED', answer_content = #{answerContent}, answered_by_member_id = #{adminMemberId}, answered_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} AND inquiry_status = 'RECEIVED'
